name: lib-env
title: Validated Environment
description: Fail-fast environment validation with zod: import { env } from '@/lib/env' and a missing or malformed variable stops the process at startup listing every problem, instead of surfacing later as an undefined in a URL or a 500 on one route. Server/client separation is enforced (a server-only key read from client code throws), a forgotten NEXT_PUBLIC_ runtime entry is a COMPILE error, and SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1 keeps a docker build with no .env working. The t3-env pattern on plain zod — no new dependency.
